description: A burst generator driven by the Collatz conjecture: a whole number is halved when even and tripled plus one when odd, and each number in the chain becomes a count of triggers filling one clock beat

params.text: Sets the whole number the chain starts from, 2 to 1000
Attenuverts the number CV, which is scaled so that one volt moves the starting number by a hundred
Returns the chain to its start on each press and silences both trigger outputs
Sets the number the chain is taken modulo, 1 to 100, which is what turns each number in the chain into a trigger count
Attenuverts the modulus CV, which is scaled so that one volt moves the modulus by ten
Arms the chain on each press; it begins on the next clock pulse

inputs.text: Each rise advances the chain by one number, and the triggers for that number are spread evenly across the time until the next rise
Shifts the starting number, scaled by a hundred and added to the number knob through its attenuverter; the total is taken as a whole number without its sign
Shifts the modulus, scaled by ten and added to the modulus knob through its attenuverter; the total is taken as a whole number without its sign
A rise returns the chain to its start; while a cable is in START, the chain then restarts straight away if that jack is above 0V
A rise arms the chain, which begins on the next clock pulse

outputs.text: Carries a burst of 10V triggers evenly spaced across one clock beat, as many as the current number modulo the modulus, each lasting half its own spacing
Carries a second burst of 10V triggers across one clock beat, as many as the current number divided by the first count and taken modulo the modulus
Carries 10V while no chain is running and 0V while one is, so it goes high when a chain reaches 1 and stops

notes: nothing comes out until a clock is patched and the chain is started, by the START button or a rise at the START jack; the two trigger outputs are forced to 0V whenever the clock jack is empty
the chain always ends: every Collatz chain reaches 1, and the module stops there and raises the END output

inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
